nphi.title: CDC Lesotho country office
nphi.with: Ministry of Health; National Reference Laboratory
nphi.summary: CDC's Lesotho office (2007) supports the MOH on HIV/TB under PEPFAR, health information and laboratory systems (National Reference Laboratory), emergency management and border health.

nphi.title: Africa CDC support to Lesotho's public health EOC and NPHI set-up
nphi.with: Ministry of Health, Lesotho (Lesotho National Public Health Institute in development)
nphi.summary: Africa CDC committed US$500,000 for equipment and frontline training to build a public health emergency operations centre as part of establishing the Lesotho National Public Health Institute, and handed over vaccine cold-chain equipment.

nphi.title: NaLaA – NLP for event-based surveillance with Africa CDC
nphi.with: Africa CDC; ProMED / ISID (USA); HISP (South Africa)
nphi.summary: Developed open-source AI tool to filter news/social media signals for Africa CDC event-based surveillance.

nphi.title: PharmTrain – Corona Global – Risk-based framework for unapproved drugs (WHO-EUL) in Southern Africa
nphi.actor: Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices (BfArM)
nphi.with: SADC; AUDA-NEPAD; WHO; national medicines regulatory authorities of SADC
nphi.summary: Developed regional emergency-use assessment framework to speed approvals in health crises.

nphi.title: Southern Africa summit on establishing and strengthening NPHIs
nphi.actor: Africa CDC Southern Africa Regional Collaborating Centre with ZNPHI
nphi.with: Africa CDC; US CDC; IANPHI; NPHIs of Lesotho, Malawi, Mozambique (INS), Namibia, South Africa (NICD) and Zimbabwe
nphi.summary: Three-day September 2019 meeting in Livingstone where Southern African NPHIs held peer exchanges on core functions, lessons and strategies, and agreed that exchange visits and peer mentorship are critical to NPHI development.
